mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with slowing growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand coupled with a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with tight labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the previous month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp in a month.
